title: Exact recovery by a backend learner
statement: Let $n,\ell,m$ be natural numbers, and let a linear solver backend over $\mathbb F_2$ return a solution satisfying any finite system of linear equations that is consistent. Let $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$ have algebraic degree at most $\ell$ after encoding its inputs and outputs in $\mathbb F_2$. If the $m$ encoded sample inputs distinguish all coefficient families on monomials of degree at most $\ell$, then the backend learner trained on those inputs with labels from $f$ evaluates to the encoded function $f$ on every input.
hypotheses_covered: a linear solver backend satisfying every consistent system it is given

target function has encoded algebraic degree at most ℓ
